## Change

Describe the problem, resulting behavior, and relevant issue.

## Validation

- [ ] `make generate`, `make test`, and `make lint` pass.
- [ ] Authentication, CSRF, validation, and transaction boundaries are covered where relevant.
- [ ] Schema changes include reviewed up/down migrations and regenerated sqlc output.
- [ ] Configuration and dependency changes are explained in the README.
- [ ] Logs exclude credentials and tokens.
- [ ] Screenshots are included for UI changes.
